releases.title: New Download Counter
changes: The top of Home and every workspace now shows a Download Counter with the real number of people who downloaded Connectchy.
Open the counter to see Roblox Studio plugin and VS Code extension installs, total files sent, and new installs from the last 30 days.

Downloads are counted by this dashboard's own database when it hands out a real plugin or extension file, once per browser or install. Only a salted hash of a random install id is stored, never an IP address or account.

releases.title: Error Fix
changes: VS Code connects using the port in your local workspace link and remembers it when reconnecting.
Workspace setup now gives VS Code the local link and gives agents their own access link.
Connection errors identify the dashboard address and explain how to reconnect. Download the updated VSIX from workspace setup.

releases.title: Better Design
changes: Chat and Tasks share a sidebar that stays in place when you switch views.
Workspace tools expand and collapse with a smooth transition.
Open the changelog from the top of Home or your workspace.
